query: Terraform fails on a nebius resource. Get a useful provider log for this ticket.
expected_behavior: Uses TF_LOG_PROVIDER_NEBIUS=DEBUG and checks for overriding TF_LOG settings.
Keeps provider and Terraform versions, relevant HCL, request Trace IDs, and the log dump.
Does not add apply or auto-approve just to reproduce the failure.
Finishes by showing artifact file paths or available download links and any available request Trace IDs; does not search for ticket tools or create/upload a ticket.
